variables.name: loop_count
variables.description: Number of completed round trips between the corridor and the bridge

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=140 beats='The reader beams aboard a silent derelict ship; a corridor loops away in both directions, and a hatch behind them still leads back to the shuttle'>>

choices.label: Have second thoughts and return to the shuttle.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=140 beats='The corridor curves past a locked door that only budges after enough passes through the ship, a route to the bridge, and a route out to the shuttle'>>

choices.label: Try the door that would not budge before.
Cut the exploration short and head for the shuttle.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=140 beats='Unfamiliar instruments blink on the bridge; the only ways onward are back down the looping corridor or out through an escape hatch'>>

choices.label: Head back down the corridor, the long way round.
Take the escape hatch and leave the ship.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Behind the stuck door, the ships log finally plays back, on the third pass through the loop, revealing what happened to the crew, a reward for a reader who explored patiently'>>
<<FILL role=completion words=90 beats='The reader reaches the escape hatch and leaves the derelict ship behind, safe but not having learned everything it held'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=80 beats='The reader turns back at the hatch before ever exploring the ship, safe and a little curious about what they left behind'>>
